status: prepared-only; no H dispatch, filesystem creation, download, Python execution, native test or ordinary acceptance is claimed

original_protocol.not_replayed: The original 441 job requires an absent whole v1 root and creates both target and binding. This job requires the v1 root/private-pins to exist and writes only a new archive; it does not replay or amend the 441 job.

native_preflight_log.meaning: 453 isolated source suite passed; native exited before helper or just test because v2 target was absent

v3_creation.meaning: First archive lstat failed before the first mkdir. This job did not create v3; the binding was not reached in that failed job.

hard_preserved_binding.validation: Complete original file descriptor hash plus lstat/fstat identity before/after. Exact recorded device/inode/UID/GID/nlink/regular-mode/size and decimal mtime/ctime must match. Probe is historical evidence; all conditions are checked again in the actual job.

preconditions_before_first_mkdir: Normal uid/euid 1000; no inherited Git location overrides
Both fixed worktrees exist canonically, have the expected HEAD/tree and complete clean status
New evidence output and both current-private and home archives are absent by actual lstat; an error other than FileNotFoundError is not absence
v1 and v2 target paths are absent by actual lstat; any reappearance is preserved and causes rejection
/data is the original canonical owned directory device 2067 inode 2 with at least the unchanged 64 GiB free-space requirement
The v1 root and private-pins directories already exist, canonically owned and mode0700; no creation branch exists
Current binding has its exact historical identity and full bytes; home/fallback bindings are not consumed
Original manifest complete hash, source Cargo.lock/resolver hashes and both original artifact records match
Original 441 and e5c receipts retain their exact complete hashes; they are history, not a claim of a present v3 target
Existing SOCKS unit has the original single reviewed forwarding address; its complete content is neither exported nor changed

mutation_scope.partial: Inside that new exclusive output; same original curl transfer, full expected length and SHA256 before install
mutation_scope.install: Open the already verified private directory fd with NOFOLLOW; create relative destination with O_CREAT|O_EXCL|O_NOFOLLOW, mode0600; copy from the verified new partial, check full source/destination bytes, fsync, chmod only that newly created fd to0400, then complete path/fd readback. An existing destination is never replaced.
mutation_scope.existing_directory_identity: device/inode/UID/GID/mode and canonical path are preserved. Directory timestamps may change because this job creates the one authorized archive.
mutation_scope.binding_identity: Full metadata including mtime/ctime remains equal; binding is only opened read-only.
forbidden: Creating v1/private-pins/target or any v2/v3 root/target
Writing, replacing, copying or chmodding binding
Overwriting an existing archive or any preexisting file
Deleting failed partials, removing directories, cleanup, reset, clean, force, signals, retries or replays
Changing production source, dependency version, Cargo.lock, resource budgets, grants, role keys, policies or services

requires: Original binding and directory identities checked again after copy
Both fixed clean sources checked again
Full installed archive hash/size and actual new descriptor/path identity
Original history and manifest full hashes checked again
completion.failure: Keep the new evidence, download partial and any actually-created archive, record failed where the output exists, and rethrow. No removal or overwrite. A partial destination must be reconciled as a failed attempt, not silently reused.
does_not_establish: Any ordinary A/B/C adoption or cold restart

followup: Only after a genuine successful archive-only receipt may Root prepare a new separately keyed v3 creation attempt/output preserving the original failed attempt. Native-only remains unbound until an actual successful v3 receipt is fully read and hashed. No CARGO_BUILD_JOBS or other build budget changes are proposed.
